summary: Reproducible count of the official MCP Registry: the same question asked three ways gives three different numbers, and this measures why.
key_features: Asks the official MCP Registry the same question three ways and shows why the three answers differ
Finds that roughly a quarter of registry entries have no source code to read
Measures the count over time instead of quoting a single snapshot
Reproducible: the sample data and the fetch/analyse pipeline are both in the repository

social.headline: How many MCP servers are there? Ask three ways, get three numbers.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written and reviewed; no field is generated from a guess
